CustomField.description: To auto-reset the HAM Trivia Attempted checkbox. If the HAM Trivia Attempted Date NOT EQUALS Null, AND HAM Trivia Attempted Date EQUALS Today's date, Then we check it, else we uncheck it.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(HAM_Trivia_Attempted_Date__c)), HAM_Trivia_Attempted_Date__c = TODAY() ), True, False )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: To auto-reset the HAM Trivia Attempted checkbox.
CustomField.label: HAM Trivia Attempted?
